name: GlideScriptableInputStream
title: GlideScriptableInputStream - Scoped, Global
summary: A GlideScriptableInputStream object cannot be instantiated directly, but is used as an opaque object which is used to connect an input stream from GlideSysAttachment.getContentStream() with other streaming APIs.
overview:
The public APIs that can consume this input stream include:
  • GlideDigest
  • GlideExcelParser
  • GlideTextReader
  • XMLDocument2
